rows.grounds: acc. sg. nt. of svaka; refers to one's own (teacher's) death-day in the teacher birth/death days context (TOC 213-216)
compound mṛti-dina, acc. sg. nt.; object of observance in the teacher death-day prescription (TOC 213-216)
yat (rel. pron., nom./acc. nt.) + tu (particle); introduces the clause about one's own death-day
tat + anyeṣām (gen. pl. of anya); contrasts one's own death-day with that of others
future 3sg. of √bhū; predicates the status of the others' death-day
nom./acc. sg. nt. of naimittika; classifies the observance as naimittika (occasional), per chapter's nitya/naimittika frame
past passive participle of √mṛ, nom. sg. m.; refers to the deceased teacher
sandhi-split: yasmāt + śiva-abhinnaḥ + tadā; gives reason: because the deceased is non-different from Śiva at that time
optative 3sg. of √bhū; expresses the resulting status or prescribed understanding
